sentences.en: A smart news consumer is always aware of this discrepancy between traditional media and social media.
sentences.zh: 明智的新闻消费者总是会注意到传统媒体和社交媒体之间的差异。

sentences.en: Tom has found some interesting discrepancies.
sentences.zh: 汤姆发现了一些有趣的差异。

senses.zh: （在事实和宣称之间的）差异或矛盾：divergence, disagreement

mnemonic: 词根记忆：dis（分开）+crep（破裂）+ ancy →裂开→矛盾
